title: Listen and Choose a Response — Errands

questions.stem: Isn't the bakery usually open on Sunday mornings?

options.A: It is, but they're closed this week for vacation.
options.B: I usually bake cookies on Sundays.
options.C: Yes, and they were closed all morning.
options.D: The bread was a little dry.

questions.explanation: This confirms the normal schedule and explains the exception. 'Yes' plus 'closed all morning' contradicts itself, and the others shift to baking and bread.
questions.speaker: f4
